settings.heading: Say what you do in one clear sentence.
settings.text: This is the first thing visitors read. Follow it with a line or two about who you help and how. To change any words on this page, click them in the preview.

settings.heading: What you offer
settings.intro: Use cards for services, products or reasons to choose you. Add, remove and reorder them in this section's list.

settings.title: The first thing you offer
settings.text: A sentence or two about it. You can add a picture above the title, and a link to a page with more detail.

settings.title: The second thing
settings.text: Keep each card about the same length, so the row lines up neatly.

settings.title: The third thing
settings.text: Three cards to a row suits most pages. Change it to two or four in the section's layout settings.

settings.heading: Tell your story
settings.body:
Pair a picture or a short, silent video with a few paragraphs. Choose which side the picture sits on, and give the section a tinted background to set it apart.

Until a picture is added, the text sits on its own like this.

settings.quote: A short quote from someone you've helped says more than a paragraph about yourself. Keep it to two or three sentences.
settings.name: Their name

settings.question: What should go here?
settings.answer: The questions you're asked most often, each answered in a few sentences. Visitors open one at a time.

settings.question: How do I add another question?
settings.answer: Add a question to this section, then type the question and its answer. Drag questions to change their order.

settings.question: Can an answer have links and lists?
settings.answer: Yes. Answers can have bold text, lists and links to other pages.

settings.heading: Ready to talk?
settings.text: End a page with one clear next step, such as getting in touch or making a booking.
